subject: Locking a demo window for Private/VPC deploy + procurement readiness
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kelly Santos <kelly.santos@curabank.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-22 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed slots for Private deployment demo

Hi Kelly —

Thanks for self-booking a Private/VPC demo via our site — really glad CuraBank is evaluating this for regulated workloads. I’m Vivek (SDR) and I’ll coordinate the initial session. Two quick things before we lock time:

1) Can you confirm whether procurement/legal needs a vendor form or PO prior to the pilot? If so, any expected approval SLA?
2) Do you require us to bring someone from ops/security to cover SOC2, data flows, and key-management (KMS/HSM)?

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Sep 1 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed Sep 2 — 13:00–14:00
- Thu Sep 3 — 09:00–10:00

We can run a 45–60 minute technical walk-through (architecture + networking + handoff checklist) and leave 15–20 for procurement/legal Q&A. I’m CC’ing Camila (solutions lead) to handle the tech ops piece.

Attached: pre-demo checklist we usually send to regulated customers.

Let me know which slot works and the procurement contact if you want them looped in before the call.

Cheers,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | SDR, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Pre-Demo_Checklist.docx (checklist, 1 page)
From: Kelly Santos <kelly.santos@curabank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@curabank.com>
Date: 2026-08-23 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed slots for Private deployment demo

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the checklist — helpful. We prefer Tue Sep 1 at 10:00 PT but need to loop procurement and legal. I’ve CC’d procurement; they have a standard vendor form we need completed and a short security questionnaire. I’ve attached the questionnaire we started filling out — it's not complete yet.

A few notes from our side:
- We will need to confirm that KMS integration can use a customer-managed key in our Azure Key Vault.
- Network team will require CIDR ranges for the demo instance to pre-approve firewall rules.
- Procurement asks for an estimated timeline to PO and any MSAs/Docs we can pre-share.

Procurement, can you confirm expected lead time for PO once the vendor form is returned?

Thanks — Kelly
Kelly Santos | Head of AI Platforms, CuraBank
kelly.santos@curabank.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: Curabank_Security_Questions.pdf (partial answers)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kelly Santos <kelly.santos@curabank.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-23 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed slots for Private deployment demo

Hi Kelly —

Great — Sep 1 at 10:00 PT works on our side. I’m looping Priyom (solutions engineer) to cover KMS, network/CIDR specifics, and the on-prem/VPC footprint. Priyom — please prepare:

- Short slide on customer-managed KMS options (Azure Key Vault + bring-your-own-key patterns)
- Example CIDR ranges and minimal ports we’ll need during the demo (we can provide a temporary whitelist)
- Copy of our standard MSA and a short summary of pilot terms (duration, data residency, logs retention) we can share with procurement ahead of time

Kelly / Procurement — to speed procurement, we can:
- Share the redlined MSA and a prefilled vendor form (we’ll mark pilot-specific clauses)
- Provide a short PO timeline: 2–3 weeks typical for pilot PO once vendor form + security questionnaire are returned and legal has reviewed

I attached our consolidated pre-demo checklist and I’ll drop the MSA + vendor form in a shared Drive after this thread. If procurement needs an accelerated path for a pilot, we can also run the demo as a technical meeting first and finalize contractual paperwork in parallel — let me know if that helps.

Camila Reyes | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0242

Attachments: Pre-Demo_Checklist.docx (v2)
From: Kelly Santos <kelly.santos@curabank.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@curabank.com>
Date: 2026-08-24 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed slots for Private deployment demo

Camila — thanks, that flow sounds exactly like what we need. Procurement confirms they can accept the vendor form and aim for PO within ~2 weeks once we have the completed questionnaire and draft MSA. Procurement is attaching the vendor form — procurement@curabank.com please confirm receipt of anything we send.

One scheduling update: Legal asked if we can move the session 30 minutes earlier to 09:30 PT on Sep 1 so they can join before another meeting. Is 09:30 PT okay for your team? If yes, please send an updated calendar invite and include the PoC calendar (.ics) with the three expected attendees: Kelly, Head of Procurement (procurement@curabank.com), and our Network Lead (netops@curabank.com).

We’ll also complete the security questionnaire and return it by EOD tomorrow. If you can pre-share the MSA and the vendor form prefilled, that would speed approvals.

Thanks all — Kelly
